synthetic-0001.title: Synthetic QASPER-format paper: entity linking with graph features
synthetic-0001.abstract: We study entity linking with graph features. This record is synthetic and only exercises the loader.

paragraphs: Entity linking maps mentions to knowledge base entries. Graph features capture relations between candidate entities.
We evaluate on the AIDA-CoNLL dataset and on the WNED-WIKI dataset.
Training uses the AIDA training split only.
Graph features improve micro F1 by 2.3 points on AIDA-CoNLL.
